summary: Iteration 90 — tested Range Management feature (backend + frontend) and verified the Inventory WoC bug fix. Backend pytest: 18/18 passed (1 skipped, no movements yet — expected). Frontend e2e: page loads, all data-testids present, KPI counts match the agent-supplied baseline (T1=0, T2=0, T3=870, T4=93), CSV downloads with the correct filename prefix, nav item is present. Inventory WoC KPI recomputes correctly when toggling Active/Retired/All — bug fix CONFIRMED.

design_issues.screen: Inventory page (pre-existing, NOT a regression introduced by this iter)
issues: Multiple recharts console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart container collapses momentarily during toggle re-render. Not visible to user but noisy in console.

React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' fires on Inventory page — appears to come from one of the <select> components (likely in a brand/subcat dropdown). Minor, but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Optional) Clean up pre-existing recharts width/height(-1) console warnings on Inventory page — likely a hidden chart container momentarily having 0 width during toggle re-renders.
(Optional) Fix the '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' React hydration warning on Inventory page — invalid HTML inside one of the <select> options.
critical_code_review_comments: range_mgmt.py is clean — pure compute, well-documented, sensible approximations. No I/O leaks into helpers.

routes/range_mgmt.py idempotency uses (style_name, to_tier, calendar-day) — verified at runtime: 2nd /classify did NOT grow the history count. However, the find_one+insert pattern inside _record_movements is racy under concurrent requests; consider a unique compound index (style_name, tier, day) + insert_one with try/except DuplicateKeyError if concurrent /classify calls become a real concern.
routes/range_mgmt.py L131-132: recent_movements is capped at 200 for response size but the /movements endpoint already returns the full list — the cap on /classify is fine.

RangeManagement.jsx is 494 lines — borderline on the 700-line file-size guideline but still under. If more sections are added, split TierKpiCard / movement table / retirement pipeline into separate components.
RangeManagement.jsx L102-124: useEffect's deps include JSON.stringify(countries)/channels — works but a useMemo over the stringified key would avoid re-stringifying on every render. Minor perf nit.

Tier filter row-count appears unchanged (75 → 75) because SortableTable.pageSize=75 caps both views and the Tier 3 bucket alone is 870 rows. Not a bug, but consider showing a 'filtered to N of M' line under the filter row for clarity (the section subtitle already shows this via SectionTitle, so OK).
Inventory WoC fix verified: Active=6.4 wks, Retired='—' (no sales history for retired styles), All='—'. Values change with toggle → fix is correct.

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 passed, 1 skipped — fresh DB has no movements yet)

seed_data_creation: First /api/range-mgmt/classify call inserts initial tier-history docs into Mongo collection style_tier_history (one per style). Subsequent calls within the same day do NOT duplicate (verified via idempotency test — movements count baseline=after).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_90_range_mgmt.py (pytest). Cold /classify takes ~30s on first hit, warm <5s. The 'no movements' skip is expected on a fresh DB — once styles cross gates between days, the /movements endpoint will return rows.
